title: 2541. Minimum Operations to Make Array Equal II

examples.explanation: In 2 operations, we can transform nums1 to nums2. 1st operation: i = 2, j = 0. After applying the operation, nums1 = [1,3,4,4]. 2nd operation: i = 2, j = 3. After applying the operation, nums1 = [1,3,7,1]. One can prove that it is impossible to make arrays equal in fewer operations.
It can be proved that it is impossible to make the two arrays equal.
